name: UnverifiedContr_0x452E25
report: Any malicious fake LP contract could invoke uniswapV3SwapCallback. The attacker deployed a malicious liquidity pool and exploited the unprotected callback to drain funds from the arbitrageur router contract.
report_zh: 任何恶意伪造的 LP 合约均可调用 uniswapV3SwapCallback。攻击者部署了一个恶意流动性池，并利用未受保护的回调函数，从套利者路由合约中盗取资金。
